identity_check: Confirmed as Workroom Automation (onworkroom.com), the Hyderabad company founded in 2022 that sells 'Workroom', a connected factory platform with an AI planning engine for medium and large manufacturers. The domain comes from the company's seed press release (Analytics Insight, 23 Mar 2026, 'https://www.onworkroom.com/'); the site, that release, Indian Chemical News (24 Mar 2026) and Venture Intelligence (23 Mar 2026) all describe the same connected-factory / planning product and name the same co-founders (Abhinav Atthota, CEO; Rohan Agarwal, CTO). The site's LinkedIn link points to a company page slugged 'leapsquare-labs', which suggests an earlier or legal name; not checked. Category set to adjacent (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from an Indian Chemical News lead): it is an Indian plant-floor software company selling to the same kind of mid-to-large manufacturers, with role-based shop-floor apps, but its functions are production, inventory and workforce planning, execution tracking and traceability (MES-like), not Utopian Autonomy's procurement, maintenance, process-stability or RFQ / BOM / drawing work, and no WhatsApp or agent interface is mentioned.

pages.title: Workroom Automation raises Rs. 6.2 crore to revolutionize manufacturing with AI-powered factory platform

company.name: Workroom Automation
company.description: Hyderabad startup building a connected factory platform whose AI planning engine turns high-mix demand into daily production, inventory and workforce plans and tracks execution.

layer_detail: Production planning and execution (MES-like) rather than design-to-manufacturing process planning: an AI planning engine for workstation, inventory and workforce planning that re-plans automatically on live constraints, plus production execution, traceability, workflow engine, web and shop-floor role-based apps, dashboards, forecasts and an integrations layer ('Factory OS'). Customers in tyres, stationery, intralogistics and consumer goods. No WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Connected factory software for medium and large manufacturers: an AI planning engine that converts high-mix demand into optimised daily production plans and adjusts them to live constraints, with modules for inventory and workforce planning, production execution, part-level traceability and order tracking, and role-based apps for office and shop-floor teams.

company.name: Workroom Automation
company.description: Hyderabad connected-factory platform with an AI production-planning engine.

rounds.stage_raw: Seed round, Rs 6.2 crore; first institutional raise

conflicts.reason: The company's press release and the database entry carry 23 March; Indian Chemical News reported it a day later.

open_items: Total raised: INR 6.2 crore (the seed, described as the company's first institutional raise). Valuation not disclosed. Angels listed in participants are those named in the press release ('among others'); it does not say how much each invested.
Founded year 2022 comes from the press release only; Indian Chemical News and Venture Intelligence do not state it.

Named customers are from the homepage customer blurbs (Apollo Tyres, Hindustan Pencils, ALSTEF Group, Plumage); press says only 'multiple factories of leading manufacturing enterprises' in automotive, electronics, industrial machinery and consumer goods.
The homepage shows a 'Launching Soon' badge despite named deployments; unclear what is unreleased.
LinkedIn company page slug 'leapsquare-labs' (linked from the site) hints at a former or legal entity name (LeapSquare Labs?); not verified, LinkedIn not opened.
Headcount not on any public page read. Revenue not publicly reported. Pricing not public.
USD equivalents vary in search results (raising.fi about $707K, CB Insights about $660K); those pages were not opened and no conversion is recorded.
